description: This file defines telemetry event types and functions for build, type check, and lint check events in a Next.js project. It includes regex patterns for identifying test and mock directories/files, and functions to generate event payloads with computed properties like page counts and presence of test or special directories.

methods.name: eventTypeCheckCompleted
methods.description: Creates an event object for type check completion with provided event data.

methods.name: eventLintCheckCompleted
methods.description: Creates an event object for lint check completion with provided event data.

methods.name: eventBuildCompleted
methods.description: Generates a build completed event, analyzing page paths for test and special directories.

methods.name: eventBuildOptimize
methods.description: Generates an optimized build event, analyzing page paths for test and special directories, and including various build metrics.
